generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending Bidder shall have successfully carried out Rebabbiting works of bearings in any Central or State Govt. or PSUs or any reputed private organizations. In this regard, the intending bidder shall have successfully carried out the said work as Prime Contractor in a single Work done of value not less than Rs.1.41 Lakh in Central or State Govt. or PSUs or any reputed private organizations in last preceding five financial years and shall furnish copy of the related Work order and Work done/work completion certificate issued by the competent authority as documentary evidence. Work done of previous years will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of financial year of tender invited.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Supply, installation & commissioning of new set of turbine side Thrust Pads for units at Shimsha HES

itemList.description:
Supply, installation & commissioning of new set of turbine side Thrust Pads for units at Shimsha HES.
1.The scope of work involves supply of new set of thrust pad of base metal made up of brass metal as per the drawing & machining and providing grooves to the base metal of the pads as per the drawing.
2.Then babbiting with white tin graded metal, machining of Tin graded Babbit metal of thickness 6mm as per drawing attached.
3.DP test shall be conduct.
4.Blue matching of Thrust pad at site.
5.After Installation of Thrust pads, alignment shall be checked
